style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern family living room. Healthy school-age child about eight lounges like a little monarch on a sofa and demands another toy with a pout and outstretched empty hand, while indulgent father kneels to tie the child's shoes and smiling mother holds a peeled fruit slice for child to eat. A grandparent offers another wrapped toy despite many untouched toys already around child. Child perfectly capable of tying shoes and eating but adults continually do everything and yield to demands. Emphasize excessive indulgent upbringing rather than ordinary care of toddler or sick child. No royal costume needed, no ridicule of illness or disability. Exactly two arms each person, each assigned one simple task, five fingers, natural shoe-lace contact and fruit grip, grounded sofa. 3:2 landscape graphite pencil watercolor colored pencil ivory paper, no labels text brands logos letters numbers watermarks.
alt: 學齡孩子坐在沙發上噘嘴伸手要新玩具，爸爸替他綁鞋帶，媽媽遞水果，長輩又送來禮物，周圍已堆著許多玩具。
